verdict.rationale: React is an open-source UI library that runs inside the developer's own app. It is not a hosted service that collects or holds user data, so an opt-out from AI-model training is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows React ingesting user data or offering any training-related data controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
